items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The inline AniBT loading mark: an <output role=status> with a spinning glyph that follows the surrounding ink.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: AniBT 「贴纸手账」 button: candy primary with gloss and a ✦ on hover, raised secondary, quiet ghost, red danger, link and field paints on shadcn's variant and size names, with a non-resizing loading state.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: AniBT tags (neutral, resolution, language, status words), die-cut stickers (paper, candy, water), counts, plus StatusBadge (dot + word) and StatusDot.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: AniBT panel: paper with a 1px edge and the panel shadow (or a flat well), A's 16/12 box with a compact density, and a stitched header or footer.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: AniBT 32px text field: paper under a 1px input ring, pink on hover, a 1.5px ring edge with the pink halo on focus, red when invalid, a sunk well when read-only or disabled.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: AniBT multi-line field: the input's material and states, growing with its content from two lines.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: AniBT field label: 13/600 in ink2 above its control; a disabled control greys it instead of fading it.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: AniBT form grammar on shadcn's field names: label above the control, tags and meta on the label row, a hint or an error under it, choice rows and cards, container-query field rows and stitched field-group cards.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: AniBT select: a field-material trigger and a floating A panel whose chosen row carries the pink label and tick.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: AniBT candy checkbox: an 18px box that turns candy with a white tick that pops in; indeterminate shows a dash.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: AniBT candy switch: a 36x20 sunk track that turns candy, with a white knob that springs across; a 28x16 small size.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: AniBT candy radio: 18px paper discs; the chosen one is candy with a white dot.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: AniBT segmented track: a sunk well of 24px choices where the chosen one is a white sticker thumb with a pink glyph, with radio semantics and an optional label.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: AniBT toggle group: the segmented track with sticker thumbs, or a row of 28px filter chips that turn pink and show a tick when pressed.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: AniBT key cap: a sunk 20px cap with a 1px floor in the round face, and KbdGroup for a chord.
items.author: AniBT <https://anibt.net>
